paint-01.speaker: Sunita
paint-01.text: Hello, Ramesh ji bol rahe hain? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha.

paint-02.speaker: Ramesh
paint-02.text: Haan ji madam, namaste. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

paint-03.speaker: Sunita
paint-03.text: Mujhe apna flat paint karwana hai. Two BHK hai, Indirapuram mein, third floor pe.

paint-04.speaker: Ramesh
paint-04.text: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony ki grill bhi karni hai?

paint-05.speaker: Sunita
paint-05.text: Andar ka poora, dono bedroom, hall aur kitchen. Balcony ki grill bhi kar dena.

paint-06.speaker: Ramesh
paint-06.text: Paint kaun sa lagwana hai? Asian Paints ka Royale loge ya normal Tractor Emulsion?

paint-07.speaker: Sunita
paint-07.text: Royale thoda costly padega. Aap Tractor Emulsion hi lagao, lekin do coat hone chahiye.

paint-08.speaker: Ramesh
paint-08.text: Do coat aur putty ka touch-up, material ke saath pachees hazaar lagega madam.

paint-09.speaker: Sunita
paint-09.text: Pachees hazaar bahut zyada hai. Mera budget twenty thousand ka hai.

paint-10.speaker: Ramesh
paint-10.text: Madam bees mein nahi ho payega, labour hi teen aadmi ka hai. Chalo baees hazaar final kar lo.

paint-11.speaker: Sunita
paint-11.text: Theek hai, twenty two thousand done. Lekin material aapka hoga, upar se koi extra charge nahi.

paint-13.speaker: Ramesh
paint-13.text: Advance kitna doge madam? Material lene ke liye paanch hazaar toh pehle chahiye.

paint-14.speaker: Sunita
paint-14.text: Paanch hazaar advance main kal GPay kar dungi. UPI pe aapka yahi number hai na?

paint-15.speaker: Ramesh
paint-15.text: Ji haan, isi number pe kar dena. Ramesh Kumar naam aayega.

paint-16.speaker: Sunita
paint-16.text: Aur balance seventeen thousand kaam poora hone ke baad, same day de dungi.

paint-17.speaker: Ramesh
paint-17.text: Madam aadha kaam hone pe thoda de dena, saat hazaar. Baaki das hazaar last mein.

paint-18.speaker: Sunita
paint-18.text: Chalo theek hai. Kaam kab se start karoge?

paint-19.speaker: Ramesh
paint-19.text: Agle somvaar se shuru kar denge, subah nau baje tak pahunch jayenge.

paint-20.speaker: Sunita
paint-20.text: Aur khatam kab tak hoga? 15 tareekh ko mere ghar pe guests aa rahe hain.

paint-21.speaker: Ramesh
paint-21.text: Paanch din ka kaam hai madam. Shukravaar tak finish, pandrah tareekh se pehle ho jayega.

paint-24.speaker: Sunita
paint-24.text: Toh final: total baees hazaar, paanch advance, saat beech mein, aur das kaam ke baad. Somvaar ko milte hain.
